description: The pie chart presents the proportional distribution across three categories labeled by hierarchy levels (shown as “Level1 - 8.2,” “Level2 - 12.1,” and “Level3 - 7.0”), indicating how the total is divided among these levels. There are three slices: Level1 is a very light blue segment labeled 30.04%, Level2 is a medium/light blue segment labeled 44.32%, and Level3 is a darker blue segment labeled approximately 25.64% (the percentage text appears faint/partially obscured but is readable). Percentage labels are placed inside the slices, while the level labels with accompanying numeric values are placed outside around the pie; there is no separate legend. No slice appears exploded or otherwise emphasized, and the segments do not appear to be arranged strictly in descending order around the circle.
